answer: Plume-Ledger Coordination Receipts. Each agent action must cite a distinct recent peer receipt; reuse beyond a karst-thin threshold invalidates the action. An attacker must acquire and spend a fresh receipt per identity per epoch, so cost scales with coordination volume, not headcount. Sybils that whisper to each other still exhaust the same receipt pool. Enforcement caps receipts per source, pricing mass coordination above honest use.
